program='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row),key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    seen=set(); boxes=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            boxes.append(cells)
    boxes.sort(key=lambda z:(min(r for r,c in z),min(c for r,c in z)))
    first=boxes[0]
    r0=min(r for r,c in first); c0=min(c for r,c in first)
    r1=max(r for r,c in first); c1=max(c for r,c in first)
    out=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    fill=out[0][0]
    for cells in boxes[1:]:
        a=min(r for r,c in cells); b=min(c for r,c in cells)
        for r,c in cells:
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v!=fill:
                y,x=r-a,c-b
                if out[y][x]==fill:
                    out[y][x]=v
                else:
                    for d in range(1,max(len(out),len(out[0]))):
                        spots=[(y,x-d),(y,x+d),(y-d,x),(y+d,x)]
                        spots=[p for p in spots if 0<=p[0]<len(out) and 0<=p[1]<len(out[0]) and out[p[0]][p[1]]==fill]
                        if spots:
                            yy,xx=spots[0]; out[yy][xx]=v; break
    return out
'''
